nodes.name: .env.example
nodes.summary: Template of environment variables for local development, covering API base URLs, Supabase auth configuration, Tauri code-signing keys, and OpenAI/Azure OpenAI API keys.

nodes.name: .unimportedrc.json
nodes.summary: Configuration for the `unimported` tool defining the app's entry point (src/index.tsx), TS/JS extensions, ignore patterns, and path aliases used to detect unused files.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Agent skill-routing guide for Codex/orgii agents, mapping task scenarios (architecture, UI, cross-layer changes) to the audit/methodology skill each should invoke before declaring work done.

nodes.name: CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Claude Code-facing mirror of the agent skill-routing guide, mapping task scenarios to the audit/methodology skill agents should invoke before finishing work in this repo.

nodes.name: CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md
nodes.summary: Project code of conduct outlining expected and unacceptable behavior for contributors and how to report violations.

nodes.name: CONTRIBUTING.md
nodes.summary: Contributor guide covering local dev setup, required checks (lint/typecheck/tests/cargo), project directory map, coding expectations, PR checklist, and CLA/security/license policies.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project README introducing ORG-II, an open-source Rust/Tauri agent IDE with agent trajectory replay, cross-session memory, and AI blame features; lists supported agents, downloads, and build-from-source instructions.

nodes.name: SECURITY.md
nodes.summary: Security policy defining supported versions, the vulnerability reporting process, response SLA, out-of-scope items, and disclosure policy.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Root npm package manifest for the ORGII Tauri desktop app, defining dependencies, devDependencies, and the full set of dev/build/test/lint/cargo scripts used across the frontend and Rust backend.
nodes.languageNotes: Scripts orchestrate a dual-stack build: webpack/esbuild for the React frontend and cargo for the Rust/Tauri backend, with dedicated cargo:test targets per Rust module (agent_core, event_store, work_station, etc.).

nodes.name: pnpm-workspace.yaml
nodes.summary: pnpm workspace configuration declaring the single root package and allow-listing native/postinstall build scripts (e.g. esbuild, @swc/core, node-sass) for pnpm's build approval gate.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the React frontend, defining path aliases (@/, @src/, @api/, @common/, @page/, @assets/), strict type checking, ES2020/ESNext module settings, and src/**/* as the compiled scope.
nodes.languageNotes: Type checking is offloaded to the IDE for build performance; the actual webpack build uses esbuild-loader or ts-loader with transpileOnly instead of tsc.
